utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Hello Sam, this is Alex from FX Digital Solutions. Do you have a quick two minutes to talk?
Hi Alex, yes. I'm just reviewing your last email.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: I'm calling to follow up on the new inventory dashboard we launched for your team on Tuesday. How is everyone finding it so far?
Overall it looks clean and much faster than our old system. However, a few of my warehouse staff mentioned they are having trouble exporting the weekly report to PDF.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: I completely understand. That is a quick fix. It usually happens if browser pop-up blockers are turned on.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: I can send over a one minute step by step guide right after this call.
Oh, that would be great. If you can email that over, we will forward it to them right away.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Aside from that, are you ready for our full training review schedule for next Thursday?
Yes, Thursday works for us. Can we add a quick segment on user permissions?

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: I'll update the meeting agenda and email it to you this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Thank you for your time, Sam.
